card.name: Opening bracket after renal impairment
card.fires_on: The word "(" right after "renal impairment", where a GFR or creatinine clearance cutoff follows. Also "rising" before creatinine or nitrogen lab values.

modes.label: Bracket before kidney cutoff
modes.description: An opening parenthesis after "renal impairment" that introduces a GFR or clearance value.
modes.example: Avoid use of aliskiren with losartan potassium tablets in patients with renal impairment<< (>>GFR <60 ml/min).

modes.label: Rising kidney lab value
modes.description: The word "rising" before a kidney lab marker such as SCr or BUN.
modes.example: If progressive renal impairment becomes evident, as indicated by a<< rising>> nonprotein nitrogen or blood urea nitrogen
